title: Master Thesis: Risk Prediction of Students Across Degree Programs
summary: A master's thesis repository predicting student dropout/risk across degree programs at BHT and THL universities, using logistic regression, decision trees, random forest, and XGBoost on original and augmented datasets. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic student records for data augmentation, validated with run_diagnostic and evaluate_quality.
evidence: data_preparation_utils.py:88 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100)' fit and used to generate synthetic student data
